t.zh: 真相机的像平面是一块传感器：高 24 mm，分成 1200 行像素，一个像素高 0.02 mm。图里的位置用像素数，焦距也可以换成像素：毫米焦距除以每个像素的大小。
t.en: A real camera's image plane is a sensor: 24 mm high, split into 1200 rows of pixels, each 0.02 mm. Positions in a picture are counted in pixels, and the focal length can be too: the focal length in millimetres over a pixel's size.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：焦距怎样决定拍得下多宽的视野，像素坐标又怎样从投影得出？先调焦距，让竖直视场正好 90°：一根灯杆离相机多远就有多高，杆顶刚好落在画面上沿；再用投影接出一块输出像素坐标的电路。
t.en: This level asks: how does the focal length decide how wide a view fits, and how do pixel coordinates come from the projection? First set the focal length so the vertical field of view is exactly 90°, a pole as tall as it is far away just reaching the frame's top edge; then wire the projection into a circuit that gives pixel coordinates.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>：焦距越长视野越窄；画面半高等于像素焦距时视场 90°。
after.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="angle-of-view-from-pixel-focal-length"></wiki-ref>: the longer the focal length, the narrower the view; when half the frame equals the focal length in pixels, the view is 90°.

brief.zh: 传感器高 24 mm、1200 像素：调焦距 f，让竖直视场正好 90°，灯杆顶刚好在画面里。
brief.en: A 24 mm, 1200-pixel-high sensor: set the focal length f so the vertical field of view is exactly 90°, the pole's top just in the frame.

hint.zh: 90° 的视场，一半是 45°：从小孔到画面上沿的那条光线，往上走的和往前走的一样多。
hint.en: Half of 90° is 45°: the ray from the hole to the frame's top edge rises as far as it goes forward.

why.zh: 以为焦距等于传感器高度时视场是 90°：那时半高 12 mm 只有焦距的一半，视场约 53°，杆顶出了画面。焦距要等于半高 12 mm。
why.en: Taking a focal length equal to the sensor's height for 90°: then the half-height, 12 mm, is half the focal length, the view about 53° and the pole's top out of frame. The focal length must equal the half-height, 12 mm.

t.zh: 像素坐标从画面左边数起，光轴穿过的那一点（主点）在画面中间，坐标是 c_x。新元件<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>。
t.en: Pixel coordinates count from the frame's left edge; the point the optical axis passes through (the principal point) sits mid-frame at c_x. New part: <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>.

brief.zh: 输入 X、Z、像素焦距 f_px 和主点 c_x：交出像点的像素横坐标 u。
brief.en: Given X, Z, the focal length in pixels f_px and the principal point c_x, give the image's pixel column u.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="project"></part-ref> 已经会算以光轴为原点的位置；像素坐标的原点在哪里？
hint.en: The <part-ref to="project"></part-ref> already gives the position measured from the axis; where is the origin of pixel coordinates?
